service_scope.value: Genuine Vermont slate (page: sourced in standard grades suited to coastal wind requirements) and premium synthetic slate (DaVinci Roofscapes, CertainTeed Belmont), plus slate repair: replacing individual tiles when most of the field is sound, re-flashing penetrations, re-nailing loose tiles. Page says slate lasts 75 to 100 years if properly installed. Page cost claims (Vermont slate about $35,000-$70,000+, synthetic about $18,000-$35,000) are unconfirmed.
service_scope.source: Live site https://apexroofingtlc.com/slate-roofing/ (read 2026-10-11) — not confirmed by the client or Paul

service_process.value: Framing is assessed first (page: slate weighs roughly 800-1,500 lbs per square vs 200-350 for architectural shingles), with possible sister-rafter or purlin reinforcement; material approval coordinated with the City of Beaufort BAR for historic properties; ARB approval is property-specific in Hilton Head communities. Cracked tiles are found by a dull sound when tapped.
service_process.source: Live site https://apexroofingtlc.com/slate-roofing/ (read 2026-10-11) — not confirmed by the client or Paul
